description: Election Commission - H. M. R. Gunathilaka was Selected as the Member of the Thalawa Pradeshiya Sabha,  A. C. Rohitha was Selected as the Member of the Kebiththigollewa Pradeshiya Sabha,. G. B. N. Chaturanga was Selected as the Member of the Anuradhapura M/C.
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Thalawa Pradeshiya Sabha, Kebiththigollewa Pradeshiya Sabha, and Anuradhapura Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of selected members to fill vacancies that occurred when previous members ceased to be party members. This falls under election-related matters as it concerns the composition of elected local government bodies through established electoral procedures.
